vibe: Synthwave pixel & Cyber neon pixel, retro-futuristic, high-contrast, glowing. A nostalgic 8-bit aesthetic upgraded with modern sleekness.

headings.usage: Use sparingly for Main App Logo, Auth Titles, or Top-level Section Headers. It is extremely wide on mobile.
headings.styling: uppercase, tracking-tight, text-shadow-sm for glowing effect

body_and_subheadings.usage: Primary font for almost all UI elements, marketplace items, deal room chats, inputs, and standard text to satisfy 'full pixel-font everywhere' while keeping readability on mobile.
body_and_subheadings.styling: tracking-normal, leading-relaxed, slightly larger base size (text-lg) as VT323 renders small

scale.body: text-xl (VT323 is small, so text-xl acts as normal base)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid-based, modular, reminiscent of 8-bit game HUDs combined with modern dense dashboards. Mobile-first layout.
spacing_and_layout.corners: Mix of square (rounded-none) for main structural containers/cards, and slightly rounded (rounded-sm or max 4px) for inner inputs, chat bubbles, and buttons.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Visible 1px or 2px solid borders. Colored with subtle neon (cyan or dark magenta) to separate elements instead of relying solely on background shifts.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Compact spacing (p-3 to p-4) for marketplace lists and chat. Generous (p-6) for Auth and Profile security panels.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Delicate and subtle, per user request. No harsh screen-shaking glitches.
motion_and_interactions.hover_active_states: Slight neon text-shadow glow increase, border color shift from cyan to hot pink.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, crisp transitions (150ms ease-in-out). Feels responsive and mechanical.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle scanline shimmer on active cards or buttons. Focus states on forms add a 2px neon ring (focus:ring-cyan-500).

component_guidelines.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (2px) corners, 1px solid border, neon text. Primary buttons use solid neon background with dark text (#050509).
component_guidelines.inputs_and_forms: Dark background (#050509), 1px solid border (border-cyan-500/30). Focus adds neon glow.
component_guidelines.cards: Surface dark background, 1px subtle neon border. For listing items, use a compact bento grid or horizontal list with a thumbnail on the left.
component_guidelines.navigation: Bottom sticky nav for mobile. Frosted glass dark background (bg-[#0f0f15]/80 backdrop-blur-md) with glowing active icons.
component_guidelines.deal_room_chat: Chat bubbles should be slightly rounded (rounded-md) with high-contrast text. Sender (Primary color border), Receiver (Secondary color border).
component_guidelines.shadcn_overrides: Override Shadcn default border radius to 0.125rem. Override font-sans to VT323. Replace Vercel-like subtle gray borders with neon-tinted dark borders.

image_urls.description: Pink neon grid. Use as a subtle low-opacity background for Auth screens or Profile header backdrop.
Futuristic cyber woman portrait. Ideal for Deal Room chat avatars or Profile picture placeholder.
Striking cyberpunk portrait with neon lights. Another chat avatar placeholder for Deal Room.

media_and_assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' but apply styling to fit the blocky aesthetic if possible, or standard clean lines. Emphasize with neon stroke colors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon backgrounds uses dark void (#050509) for APCA compliance.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable glitch or pulse effects if user prefers reduced motion.

testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='auth-submit-button', data-testid='marketplace-search-input').
instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) across Auth screens, Marketplace, Create Listing flow, Deal Room, and Profile panels.
Import Google Fonts: 'Press Start 2P' and 'VT323'. Map them in tailwind.config.js to your font-sans and font-mono.
Use VT323 for 90% of the app to satisfy 'pixel font everywhere' while ensuring it fits on mobile web app displays.
Customize Shadcn components heavily: strip gradients, add 1px neon borders, set --radius to 2px, set --background to #050509.
Keep animations very delicate per user request (fast transitions, subtle hover glows, no aggressive screen tearing).
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements without fail.
